capabilities.name: Capability Questions
can_do: answer what Luna can do
explain documented limits
explain whether a feature is available
offer the closest supported alternative
cannot_do: execute a mutation solely because the user asked whether it is possible
invent undocumented product capabilities
capabilities.fallback: State that the capability is not documented as supported and avoid claiming execution.
capabilities.verification: No mutation should occur.
aliases: explain whether a feature is available

capabilities.name: Generate Website Pages
can_do: generate pages from registered Sparks
compose pages for documented page intents
inherit an established site theme
use an approved first-build design direction
cannot_do: invent unsupported page builders or arbitrary runtime systems
silently rebrand an established site during normal page generation
capabilities.fallback: Generate the closest supported page composition using registered Sparks.
capabilities.verification: Confirm that generated page blocks were persisted.
aliases: compose pages for documented page intents
use an approved first-build design direction

capabilities.name: Section Content Editing
can_do: edit headings and copy
edit labels and URLs
edit repeatable items
preserve existing layout for content-only requests
cannot_do: claim a redesign when only copy changed
mutate unrelated fields in a narrow edit
capabilities.fallback: Apply the smallest supported edit and preserve unrelated content.
capabilities.verification: Compare before/after block state.
aliases: preserve existing layout for content-only requests

capabilities.name: Section Redesign
can_do: replace with a materially different compatible registered Spark
preserve semantic section purpose and useful content
respect existing site theme unless explicitly rebranded
cannot_do: return the same layout while claiming a redesign when alternatives exist
use an incompatible Spark only because it has requested media
capabilities.fallback: Use the closest compatible registered Spark or explain that no safe alternative is available.
capabilities.verification: Verify a material block/layout change.
aliases: preserve semantic section purpose and useful content
replace with a materially different compatible registered spark
respect existing site theme unless explicitly rebranded

capabilities.name: Named Theme Changes
can_do: change the site theme when explicitly requested
apply theme-linked design tokens site-wide
cannot_do: randomly switch themes during ordinary redesign/content requests
capabilities.fallback: Preserve the current theme.
capabilities.verification: Verify global theme state changed.
aliases: change the site theme when explicitly requested

capabilities.name: AI Brand Color Family
can_do: design a premium semantic color family around an explicit HEX
keep the exact user HEX as primary anchor
map family into headings, surfaces, buttons, borders, links, semantic status colors and gradients
use deterministic repair/fallback for invalid AI palette output
cannot_do: drift the requested HEX away from the primary anchor
bypass server contrast validation
capabilities.fallback: Use deterministic validated premium family around the requested HEX.
capabilities.verification: Verify My Brand palette persisted and active site theme points to it.
aliases: design a premium semantic color family around an explicit hex
keep the exact user hex as primary anchor
use deterministic repair/fallback for invalid ai palette output

generate a logo through Luna when image generation is available
change the header logo without silently replacing footer logo

limits.rendering: preserve aspect ratio and centralized responsive bounds

cannot_do: charge manual Media Library selection as an AI action
capabilities.fallback: Use Media Library/manual logo selection.
capabilities.verification: Verify header.logo_image_url changed and footer remains unchanged unless explicitly requested.
aliases: change the header logo without silently replacing footer logo
choose a logo from media library
generate a logo through luna when image generation is available

capabilities.name: Header Navigation
can_do: add menu items
rename menu items
change URLs
remove menu items
reorder sibling items
create submenus
cannot_do: create a fourth navigation level
create or enable a header Mega Menu
capabilities.fallback: Offer standard nested dropdown navigation up to three levels.
capabilities.verification: Validate resulting menu tree depth and persisted global header state.

capabilities.name: Header Mega Menu
cannot_do: enable a header Mega Menu
claim Mega Menu is available in header
capabilities.fallback: Use standard header dropdown navigation up to three levels. Mega Footer is available separately.
capabilities.verification: No header mega-menu mutation should occur.

capabilities.name: Header CTA
can_do: edit CTA label
edit CTA URL
cannot_do: mutate unrelated header content during a CTA-only request
capabilities.fallback: Use manual CTA editor.
capabilities.verification: Verify CTA label/URL changed globally.

capabilities.name: Global Footer
can_do: edit footer logo
edit tagline/text
manage footer links
edit contact details
edit social links
edit CTA
edit privacy/terms/copyright
cannot_do: mutate header when user targets footer only
capabilities.fallback: Use documented manual footer editing.
capabilities.verification: Verify global_footer changed and persists across pages.

capabilities.name: Mega Footer
can_do: enable or disable Mega Footer
manage columns
manage links in columns
edit CTA/tagline/contact/social content
cannot_do: treat Mega Footer as a header Mega Menu
capabilities.fallback: Use standard footer if Mega Footer is not desired.
capabilities.verification: Validate footer schema limits and persistence.

capabilities.name: Media Library Selection
can_do: select existing media assets
cannot_do: generate a new AI image without invoking the AI path
capabilities.fallback: Upload or select an existing media asset.
capabilities.verification: Verify selected asset URL/ID is applied.

capabilities.name: AI Image Generation
can_do: generate images through configured AI image service
generate logos through documented logo workflow

generate logos through documented logo workflow

capabilities.name: Video Media
can_do: use documented supported video sources/integration paths
use direct video links where product workflow supports them

capabilities.name: Publish Website
can_do: invoke supported publishing workflow
report verified publish result
cannot_do: claim publish succeeded before runtime verification
capabilities.fallback: Report the publish failure accurately and provide supported next step.
capabilities.verification: Publishing workflow must return success.

capabilities.name: Builder and Live Visual Parity
can_do: use same semantic design system in Builder and compiler
preserve shell, typography, spacing, radius, media and responsive intent
cannot_do: treat Builder-only chrome as live website content
capabilities.fallback: Flag parity mismatch for product QA/patching.
capabilities.verification: Compare representative Builder and published/live renders.
aliases: use same semantic design system in builder and compiler

capabilities.name: Manual Editing
can_do: perform exposed CMS manual edits
use contextual Edit manually controls where available
cannot_do: consume credits without an actual billable AI/API request
perform AI-only generation while pretending it is manual
capabilities.fallback: Use Luna for AI-required operations.
capabilities.verification: Verify target data changed with no AI charge.
aliases: use contextual edit manually controls where available

capabilities.name: Large Creative Confirmation
can_do: prepare and store a large creative plan before execution
ask the user to confirm before the large action runs
resume the exact stored plan from yes/proceed/go ahead/do it

treat an unrelated yes as confirmation when no pending plan exists
claim the large action completed before execution is verified

capabilities.verification: The exact stored planner payload/operations must be resumed only when the page-state fingerprint still matches.
aliases: ask the user to confirm before the large action runs

prepare and store a large creative plan before execution
resume the exact stored plan from yes/proceed/go ahead/do it

can_do: open the normal Luna chat with selected target context
show Luna typing/looking-at state instead of a separate green context bubble
keep the selected section/element/header/footer attached to the same chat
offer Edit manually · 0 credits inside the same chat
preserve the existing global Luna conversation rather than creating another assistant
cannot_do: create a separate independent conversation identity/history
auto-run an AI mutation merely because the contextual icon was clicked

open the normal luna chat with selected target context
